content.text: Digital creators in countries like Nigeria, Ghana, and Kenya face significant obstacles when it comes to [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/selling-digital-products-without-stripe-which-architecture-actually-17|selling]] design assets online. Conventional platforms like PayPal and Stripe are often unavailable or heavily restricted, leaving creators without effective payment solutions. This gap creates a pressing need for a viable alternative that allows for seamless transactions and control over their digital products. By utilizing automated [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/crypto-payments-tanzanian-online-sellers-broken-here-infrastructure-2|COREMERCH guide to crypto]] payments through [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/full-infrastructure-guide-selling-design-assets-crypto-payments-6|The Full]] like NOWPayments, creators can sell ebooks, templates, and more without incurring prohibitive fees. This breakdown explains how to structure your sales process effectively and independently.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto-first-principles-definitive-4. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.
content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Design assets

Selling design assets with crypto payments represents a paradigm shift for digital creators. It eliminates reliance on traditional payment processors that impose high fees and restrictions. For example, Gumroad charges a steep 10% on every sale, while NOWPayments only takes 0.5%. This difference can have a substantial impact; if you sell 100 products at $97 each, you retain an additional $921. By opting for a crypto-based payment solution, creators gain both financial freedom and more control over their sales and distribution.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

At the core of this infrastructure is a combination of free and open-source tools that facilitate seamless e-commerce transactions. Using platforms like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, alongside Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers for backend logic, creators can build a reliable system for product delivery. Automated delivery is handled through these tools, ensuring that customers receive their digital products instantly after payment confirmation. NOWPayments processes transactions in over 300 cryptocurrencies, providing flexibility and reducing transaction costs. This architecture empowers creators with full data ownership and sovereignty.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is specifically designed for digital creators who operate in regions where conventional payment solutions are not viable. Whether you're selling ebooks, courses, templates, or design assets, the architecture allows you to transact freely, without the constraints of traditional platforms. This is especially relevant for creators in countries facing currency volatility and online payment restrictions. By leveraging this architecture, you can focus on your creative work without the constant worry of payment processing limitations.
Embrace true sovereignty by owning your digital storefront.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The primary components of this digital commerce stack include hosting platforms, backend logic tools, and payment processing solutions. GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages serve as the foundation for hosting your online store. Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers facilitate backend processes, while NOWPayments ensures that you can accept payments in cryptocurrency. This comprehensive infrastructure is designed for ease of use and allows you to launch your own store with minimal technical expertise. Each element works together to create a robust and scalable selling solution.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To get started with selling your design assets using crypto payments, first, choose your hosting platform, either GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Next, set up backend logic using Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers to automate order processing. Integrate NOWPayments for cryptocurrency transactions and ensure your products are uploaded and ready for sale. For immediate deployment, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197), which includes all the necessary blueprints and templates to get your store up and running swiftly. This is your pathway to sovereign commerce.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

The fastest path to your first sovereign digital product sale is a three-step process. First, create a NOWPayments account — configure your wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as starting points, generate your API key, and set the webhook endpoint URL. Second, choose your stack: Stack 01 uses GitHub Pages plus Google Apps Script and takes most creators four to six hours following the Sovereign Blueprint at $47; Stack 02 uses Cloudflare Pages plus Workers plus Supabase and is deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours with the Edge Commerce Stack at $197. Third, upload your product files, set your prices in USD, and run a complete mainnet test transaction before promoting.
Reduce transaction fees significantly by using NOWPayments instead of traditional platforms.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you're interested in launching your own digital download store that operates solely on crypto, explore the Complete Builder Kit ($197) available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html. This kit provides all the necessary blueprints and templates to build your sovereign commerce stack, ensuring you have everything you need to succeed.
Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.

You can sell ebooks online by using a combination of GitHub Pages for hosting, Google Apps Script for order management, and NOWPayments for accepting crypto payments. This eliminates the need for traditional payment processors.

The best way to sell digital downloads without incurring platform fees is to utilize a sovereign commerce stack that includes free hosting, backend automation, and NOWPayments for crypto transactions, which only charges a 0.5% fee.

Yes, you can sell templates and fonts by creating your own online store using free hosting options and integrating cryptocurrency payment processors like NOWPayments, ensuring you retain full control.
How can I ensure instant product delivery?
To ensure instant product delivery, implement automated systems using Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers to process orders immediately after payment confirmation through NOWPayments.
What cryptocurrencies can I accept for my digital products?
With NOWPayments, you can accept over 300 cryptocurrencies, allowing you to cater to a wide range of customers and preferences.
